'''Tagta's Winter Palace''' was a residence maintained by [[Tagta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It had a private kitchen staffed by several beings; the [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Cecil Noone]] and [[Kels Turkhorn]] posed as [[Chef/Legends|chefs]] assiged to Tagta's Winter Palace when infiltrating the ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' to pull off a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]].<ref name="J15" />
